purpose: Locate residual CONTROL withholding relative to a software tc egress pass-action counter, root qdisc and the existing post-qdisc AF_PACKET tap

phases: N0:4 SENSOR-source-port negative-control packets forwarded without counter increment
N4 root 100% loss:16 selected packets counted by pass action, absent at both taps/receiver
preflights.required: exact known selected-counter/native/PCAP/receiver populations, no capture loss, unchanged offload features, filter removed; no retry
complete pass/root observer logs, neighbor/provider/command/native diagnostics and successful readbacks

failure_policy: Retain original verdict/errors. No retries/replacement. Stop before subsequent steps if a preflight or observer-integrity prerequisite fails.
observers: software tc egress UDP CONTROL-to-owned-peer u32 gact PASS counter, preference49150
root-only qdisc counters/gauges, separately bracketed non-atomic reads
native monotonic v2 and immediate PCAP
analysis: Use unchanged all fully observed old-flow source gaps>=1s and active CONTROL event criteria
Correlate only adjacent observer reads wholly inside selected gaps; retain cadence/read spans and aggregate selector limitations
Retain provider identities, neighbor state/MAC, and all source CONTROL flows in the interval; counter is peer/port aggregate rather than per-SRT-socket
If pass counters increase with zero source CONTROL tap observations, locate a difference after the tested classifier and before the tested tap, without uniquely assigning queue/drop cause
If provider counters increase but pass counters remain flat, retain that distinction without uniquely assigning socket/route/accounting cause
Root drop/packet counters cover the whole interface; do not assign their deltas to CONTROL or sum overlapping child counters
Retain command UNKNOWNs, skips, sensor deficits and immutable journal audit; preserve earlier failed runs
limits: PASS classifier changes the software processing path and adds observer work; it is not the passive AF_PACKET observer
Root configuration is checked unchanged; existing classifier hooks are refused
Permanent neighbor is a separate L2 candidate; dynamic remains default
One diagnostic is not full N5/M3 or a historical reset fix
No exact packet pairing, physical delivery/realtime, observer-free equivalence, security parity or performance claim
Only owned disposable containers are changed; no host network, SRT policy/timeout/dependency/runtime changes
prerequisites: eight runtime hashes match previously tested SDK/ROS build
plan and observer source committed before synthetic probe
